preconditions.description: The input hexadecimal string S has length at most 14.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S consists only of valid lowercase hexadecimal digits.
At least one character in S is non-zero.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout) == len(S) and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in stdout) and int(stdout, 16) == min_val)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output a lowercase hexadecimal string of length equal to S representing the smallest possible numerical value of the original string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (sorted(stdout) == sorted(S) and abs(int(stdout, 16) - int(S, 16)) == int(S, 16) or abs(int(stdout, 16) - (int(stdout, 16) + int(S, 16))) == int(S, 16))
postconditions.description: The output string (if not 'NO') must be a permutation of S, and there must exist a permutation P of S such that the absolute difference between the numerical values of the output and P equals the numerical value of S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (int(stdout, 16) == min((val for val in (int(''.join(p), 16) for p in __import__('itertools').permutations(S)) if any(abs(val - int(''.join(q), 16)) == int(S, 16) for q in __import__('itertools').permutations(S) if sorted(''.join(q)) == sorted(S))))
postconditions.description: The output string represents the minimum numerical value among all valid original strings that satisfy the permutation and difference constraints.
